from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingStartRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single data point for housing starts from a monthly report."""
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The period the data applies to (YYYY-MM)")
    region: str | None = Field(description="The geographic region name (e.g., 'Northeast', 'United States')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="Not seasonally adjusted housing starts value")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The release date of the report (YYYY-MM) to determine precedence for conflicting data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_starts: list[HousingStartRecord]
